question: For delivered order items where the seller and customer are in the same state, what is the average delivery time in days (fractional days from purchase to customer delivery)?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN sellers s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND c.customer_state = s.seller_state
)
SELECT 
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM delivered
plan: - Filter orders to status 'delivered' and join to order_items, customers, and sellers. - Ensure seller_state equals customer_state. - Compute delivery time as the difference between order_purchase_timestamp and order_delivered_customer_date in days. - Aggregate by taking the average of these delivery times across all qualifying order items. - No additional grouping needed; return a single numeric result.
